verdict.rationale: Consensus documents a REST API and MCP server that use bearer-token authentication, with API keys issued via subscription. Nothing in the evidence shows scoped, permission-limited, or least-privilege credentials that could be issued to an agent. Plain bearer-token API keys are an adjacent capability, not scoped credentials, and the developer docs were walled, so no scoping detail could be verified.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
